records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription ARR in the second quarter of 2022 was $2.1 billion and grew 27% year-over-year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Deferred revenues decreased $108.8 million as of June 30, 2022 compared to December 31, 2021 primarily due to a decrease in deferred maintenance and support revenue of $149.3 million, mostly from Workspace perpetual software maintenance, partially offset by an increase in deferred subscription revenue of $45.6 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We incurred $20.9 million of expenses related to the Merger, of which $3.2 million and $18.8 million were expensed during the three and six months ended June 30, 2022, respectively, and are included in General and administrative expense in the accompanying condensed consolidated statements of income.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Also, operating cash flows increased $89.8 million to $446.4 million when comparing the six months ended June 30, 2022 to the six months ended June 30, 2021.
